name: search-results-list
title: Search results list
description: The body of a site search page: result count, type filters with counts as links, results with path and marked snippet, and pagination.
docs: total counts the results of the current filter across all pages; results holds this page only. Every filter and page is a URL (filters[].href, pageHref), so it works as plain HTML, and the snippet is plain text with the query's words marked, never injected HTML. Mark the filter that is on with current: true. Pass labels to translate the count line and the pager, linkAs={Link} for your router, and a filtersLabel of its own for each list on a page.
